title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
### **About Fairlo**


The story of Fairlo began when our founders, Jimmy and Shamon, saw first-hand how unfair and predatory lending practices can trap people in cycles of debt. Their mother had been misled by a large bank, and instead of being offered a lifeline, she was pushed further into financial difficulties.


That injustice sparked an idea: to build a company that reimagines credit, rooted in transparency, flexibility, and respect. That company became Fairlo.


Since launching in 2018, we've helped tens of thousands of people access fairer, more flexible credit. Today, we have around 50,000 active customers, an outstanding Trustpilot rating, and a team of passionate people across Stockholm, Crete, and the UK.


We've built something we're incredibly proud of. But what comes next is even more exciting.

### **The next chapter. And why you should be part of it.**


Fairlo is becoming a bank. And we're rethinking how we build technology along the way. We're entering a new phase where technology will play an even bigger role in everything we do. New products, new possibilities, more complex challenges, and an opportunity to build financial services that genuinely make people's lives better. At the same time, our AI transformation is already under way. There's a plan, and people across Fairlo are working on it every day as we become an AI-native organisation.


We want to challenge old assumptions about how software gets built. Experiment with new tools and ways of working. Move from idea to impact faster. And create an engineering culture where curiosity, creativity, and great judgment matter more than ever. We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer who wants to join that work and help shape where it goes next.


You'll join our Stockholm team, working closely with CTO, Product, Design, and our engineering colleagues in Crete. We're a small organisation with big ambitions, which means you'll be close to the decisions, the challenges, and the impact of what you build.


This isn't a role where you'll simply pick up tickets and write code. We want you to understand the problems we're solving, challenge how we approach them, and help turn ambitious ideas into great products. You'll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to own your work, and the opportunity to influence both our technology and how we work with it.

### **What you'll do**


As a Fullstack Engineer at Fairlo, you'll work across the entire product experience, from the interfaces our customers interact with to the services and systems powering them.


You'll be part of a cross-functional crew with real ownership, working together to solve meaningful problems and deliver value to our customers.


Here's what that looks like:

* Build products that matter. Design and develop intuitive customer experiences, scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations that make financial services simpler, smarter, and fairer.
* Own problems, not just code. Be involved from the first idea to the finished product. Understand the customer's needs, contribute to the solution, build it, ship it, and learn from the results.
* Build on the AI work already under way. Explore how AI can fundamentally improve the way we build software, from prototyping and development to testing, debugging, and delivery. Experiment, challenge existing practices, and help turn new possibilities into everyday ways of working.
* Make great technical decisions. Balance speed, simplicity, scalability, and security as we build technology that needs to perform today and grow with us tomorrow.
* Work close to the business. Collaborate directly with Product, Design, and colleagues across Fairlo. Your ideas and perspectives will matter, and you'll have the opportunity to influence what we build and why.
* Raise the bar together. Share knowledge, challenge assumptions, bring fresh ideas, and help create an engineering culture where talented people continuously learn and get better.

### **Who you are**


We're looking for someone who loves building things, gets excited about solving real problems, and is genuinely curious about what's next in technology. You're comfortable moving between frontend and backend, enjoy taking ownership, and care just as much about the customer experience as you do about the code behind it. And while you're a strong engineer today, you're even more interested in what you could become tomorrow.

**We believe you'll thrive at Fairlo if you:**

* Have solid professional experience in fullstack development, with strong skills across both frontend and backend.
* Are comfortable with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript, as well as backend frameworks such as Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, .NET, or similar.
* Have experience building APIs, working with relational databases, and developing scalable, cloud-based applications, preferably using AWS.
* Are already exploring how AI can make you a better engineer, and are excited to push beyond traditional development practices.
* Care about building great products, not just great code. You enjoy understanding the bigger picture and finding smart, simple solutions to complex problems.
* Take initiative, challenge ideas constructively, and feel comfortable making decisions and taking responsibility.
* Thrive in collaborative environments where people trust each other, share knowledge, and move quickly without unnecessary hierarchy.
* Communicate confidently in English, our shared working language.

#### **Nice to have**

* Experience with microservices, automated testing, and CI/CD.
* Experience building AI-powered features or working with AI coding agents and modern AI-assisted development workflows.
* Experience working in fintech, financial services, or other regulated environments.
* Contributions to open-source projects or personal projects that show your curiosity and passion for technology.


We don't expect you to tick every box. What matters most is that you're a great engineer with the curiosity, ambition, and mindset to keep evolving.

### **Why Fairlo?**


There are plenty of places where you can write great code. We want Fairlo to be a place where you can do much more than that.


A rare moment to join. We're transitioning from fintech to bank, creating an exciting mix of startup energy, ambitious product development, and new technical challenges.


A real voice in what we build. We're small enough that your ideas can make a difference immediately, but ambitious enough that the problems you'll solve are anything but small.


Join an AI transformation with momentum. You'll join Fairlo's AI transformation, already under way, with a plan and a team behind it. You'll have colleagues to build with and plenty of room to shape where it goes next.


Talented people, without the egos. You'll work with smart, passionate colleagues who care about what they do, support each other, and believe that great things happen when people are trusted.


A mission worth getting behind. We're building financial services that put people first. The technology you create will have a real impact on real lives.

**You'll also get:**

* To be part of building a financial world you'd like to live in.
* Competitive salary
* Pension (ITP level)
* Health insurance
* Health & wellness allowance
* 30 days vacation per year plus "klämdagar" off
* Possibility to use the Fairlo Cretan house for both work and vacation stay
* Possibility to bike leasing
* Hybrid working model with a top-location office in Stockholm
* Great equipment and the tools you need to do your best work
* Opportunities to learn, grow, and experiment with new technologies
* A culture that genuinely values wellbeing, flexibility, and having fun together

### **Come build what's next.**


We're building a bank. Our AI transformation is already under way. And we're looking for people who want to help shape what comes next. If you're the kind of engineer who gets excited about new possibilities, loves turning ideas into reality, and wants to work somewhere your contribution genuinely matters, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Director - Addovation
description:
Do you want to shape how AI creates value for customers, colleagues and businesses? At Addovation, AI is already part of our everyday work in delivery, support, sales and in the solutions we build for our customers. We're now looking for a AI Director who wants to take our AI journey to the next level and play a key role in driving business impact and innovations. With a clear mandate from the leadership team and sponsorship across the business, you will have the opportunity to turn AI ambitions into measurable business outcomes.
  
  

About the role AI is transforming the way businesses operate, and at Addovation we see tremendous opportunities to help both our customers and our own organization benefit from that change. As AI Director, you will lead the direction of AI across Addovation. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities, turning ideas into scalable solutions, and ensuring AI becomes a natural part of the way we work and deliver value. This is a strategic role with a strong operational element, where you will collaborate closely with business leaders, consultants, developers and customers across the organization.
  
  

You will lead Addovation's AI Council, bringing together stakeholders from across the organization to align priorities, accelerate adoption and ensure business value. You will have the opportunity to influence both our initial AI adaption and the AI-powered services we bring to the market. What you'll do As AI Director, you will: - Define and drive Addovation’s AI strategy, roadmap and priorities. - Define the direction for AI platforms, data foundations and AI agent architectures, ensuring solutions can be deployed securely and at scale.
  
  

* Drive an AI-first way of working across delivery, sales and operations, helping teams embed AI naturally into daily work while taking advantage of “old school” competencies and capabilities where suitable. - Work closely with business units to develop AI-powered offerings and services within areas such as IFS, NetSuite, Oracle and Microsoft technologies. - Lead and coordinate AI initiatives across functions, ensuring business goals and technology capabilities align. - Drive AI adoption internally by enabling teams with tools, knowledge and best practices.
* Establish governance, security and compliance frameworks for responsible AI usage. - Collaborate with IT and security teams to ensure AI solutions meet regulatory and organizational requirements. - Build and lead a network of AI Ambassadors who support adoption, knowledge sharing and experimentation throughout the organisation. - Represent Addovation externally in customer dialogues, partnerships, industry forums and market activities.
* Create value through new and enforced commercial models Is this you? We believe you are passionate about how technology can create meaningful business outcomes. You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy turning opportunities into practical solutions. You are a strong communicator who can engage with both technical specialists and business stakeholders.


You are curious, forward-thinking and motivated by helping others succeed through technology. Most importantly, you are excited about the possibilities AI creates while remaining pragmatic about how to generate sustainable and long-term value. What experience you'll likely have You likely have several years of experience working with technology, business systems, digital transformation or consulting. You have experience leading initiatives and bringing together people, processes and technology to achieve business goals.
  
  

**We also believe you have:** - Experience driving strategic technology initiatives and business transformation. - Strong understanding of AI technologies, trends and practical applications. - Experience working with cloud platforms, data-driven solutions or enterprise software environments. - The ability to bridge business needs and technical possibilities.
  
  

* Experience collaborating with executive stakeholders and cross-functional teams. We'd be even happier if you also have - Experience from ERP environments such as IFS, Oracle NetSuite or similar platforms. - Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI frameworks and regulatory requirements, including the EU AI Act. - Experience building AI-powered products, services or advisory offerings.
* Experience working in consulting or customer-facing environments. This is Addovation We are a Nordic IT company helping organisations streamline and improve their business processes through innovative business solutions. By combining deep expertise within IFS, Oracle NetSuite and Microsoft technologies, we help our customers create smarter, more efficient ways of working. Today, Team Addovation consists of more than 200 consultants, specialists and developers across Sweden, Norway and Finland.


Together, we create simple and innovative solutions that make a real difference. Why choose Addovation? At Addovation, you'll have the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a growing and innovative company. We believe in collaboration, entrepreneurship and continuous learning, and we encourage our employees to influence both their own development and the future direction of our business.
  
  

You'll join a company where ideas are welcomed, initiative is valued, and AI is seen as a strategic opportunity to create long-term value for customers and colleagues alike. How to apply? If you're excited about helping customers and colleagues unlock the value of AI, we'd love to hear from you. Submit your application through our career page.
  
  

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Administrator, Seline Schildt, at seline.schildt@addovation.com. We look forward to your application and the opportunity to get to know you.

title: Supplier Relations Leader – Cloud, Infrastructure, Data & AI Platforms
description:
**Company Description**  

We are reshaping how we work with Indirect Procurement.


Indirect Procurement is making significant changes. Our new Indirect Procurement organisation will enable us to work smarter, simplify how we operate and create more value. With clearer roles, stronger collaboration and a foundation for AI and automation, we are building a future-ready organisation together.

 **Job Description** **Shape strategic partnerships across cloud, infrastructure, data and AI**


The best supplier relationships are about much more than contracts and performance reviews. As Supplier Relations Leader for Cloud, Infrastructure, Data & AI Platforms, you will own strategic relationships with some of IKEA’s most important global technology suppliers.


Your portfolio may include suppliers such as Microsoft, AWS, Oracle and Databricks. You will work at the intersection of commercial strategy, cloud transformation, technology platforms, data and AI. Together with internal stakeholders and suppliers, you will translate IKEA’s technology priorities into stronger partnerships, improved commercial outcomes and long-term value creation.

**Why this role matters**


Cloud, infrastructure, data and AI platforms are increasingly important to IKEA’s digital capabilities, operational resilience and future development.


The suppliers within this ecosystem operate complex commercial and consumption models and have significant influence on IKEA’s technology direction and cost base. Managing these partnerships requires more than traditional supplier management. It requires strong commercial leadership, sufficient technology-market understanding and the ability to engage credibly with senior technology, architecture, engineering and platform stakeholders.


You will help IKEA optimise strategic technology partnerships, strengthen negotiation capability and reduce dependency on external expertise. You will contribute to building and retaining deeper cloud, infrastructure and platform knowledge within IKEA.

**A day in your life with us**


You will:

* Own strategic relationships with major cloud, infrastructure, data and AI platform suppliers.
* Develop supplier strategies aligned with IKEA’s technology and business priorities.
* Lead executive governance, strategic reviews and joint business planning.
* Drive supplier performance, development, innovation and long-term value creation.
* Support complex commercial negotiations, renewals and strategic agreements.
* Challenge supplier pricing, consumption, licensing and commitment models.
* Connect supplier roadmaps with IKEA’s cloud, infrastructure, data and AI strategies.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, platform simplification and improved commercial governance.
* Build IKEA’s internal knowledge and negotiation capability for major technology platforms.
* Work closely with Procurement, Technology & Platforms, architecture, engineering, data and other business stakeholders.
* Identify and mitigate supplier, concentration, commercial, operational and technology risks.
* Manage escalations and support resilience and business continuity.

  

**Qualifications** **Who you are**


You understand the strategic importance of cloud, infrastructure, data and AI ecosystems and how these platforms shape both technology capability and commercial outcomes.


You can translate technical and commercial complexity into clear supplier strategies and decisions. You do not need to be an engineer, but you have sufficient technology understanding to challenge global platform providers and operate credibly with senior technology stakeholders.


We believe you bring:

* Strong experience in supplier relationship management, sourcing, procurement or technology commercial management.
* Experience managing hyperscalers, cloud providers, infrastructure suppliers, data platforms or comparable strategic technology partners.
* Understanding of cloud economics, infrastructure and platform ecosystems.
* Knowledge of cloud consumption, enterprise commitments, licensing and commercial models.
* Experience supporting complex technology negotiations, renewals or strategic agreements.
* Understanding of cloud transformation, data platforms and AI-enabled technology ecosystems.
* The ability to connect supplier capabilities and roadmaps with enterprise technology priorities.
* Experience managing strategic or business-critical supplier relationships.
* Strong commercial understanding and negotiation capability.
* Experience driving supplier performance, innovation and joint value creation.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* The ability to engage credibly with architecture, engineering, platform and senior technology stakeholders.
* The ability to manage ambiguity, risk and complex business situations.

*Experience working directly with suppliers such as Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Databricks or comparable global technology-platform providers would be an advantage.*

 **Additional Information**  

The position can be located in Malmö (SE) or Delft (NL) or Warsaw (PL).


We recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group who are impacted by organisational changes, provided the competence requirements for the role are met.


We look forward to receiving your application in **English latest by 17th November 2026.**


Please not for this position we do not offer relocation support.


If you have questions about the role, please contact Hiring Manager Diederik Hagreis at diederik.hagreis@inter.ikea.com and if you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact Recruiter Femina Karlsson at femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Data Center Technician Overview As a Data Center Technician (DCT) at Microsoft, you will deploy, maintain, troubleshoot, and decommission the hardware that supports our cloud services. You will stage and install equipment, diagnose faults, replace components, and complete hardware upgrades and refreshes in line with standard procedures. You will join Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, which supports services including Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Bing. This role offers opportunities to deepen your technical skills, learn from experienced colleagues, and support other technicians as you grow.
  
  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset and build an inclusive culture grounded in respect, integrity, and accountability. Responsibilities Stage, set up, and deploy datacenter hardware in accordance with standard operating procedures. Diagnose and troubleshoot equipment issues, identify root causes, and replace faulty components while minimising disruption.
  
  

Complete post-deployment quality checks, verifying that grounding, staging, labelling, and cabling meet safety and deployment standards and planned Network Design Tasks. Decommission hardware and carry out straightforward changes and refreshes, such as memory upgrades and rebuilds, following established procedures. Report and escalate incidents to technician leads, datacenter operations management, or engineering specialists as appropriate. Help other technicians complete challenging tasks and share knowledge across the team.
  
  

Complete required training and learn from experienced technicians through hands-on work. Contribute to team meetings, communicate work status, and collaborate to resolve issues. Take ownership of the quality and completeness of your work, while following security, data-handling, and safety procedures. Embody Microsoft’s culture and values.
  
  

Required Qualifications Completed secondary education, GED, apprenticeship, vocational qualification, or equivalent practical experience, with knowledge of computer hardware and components. Experience diagnosing and troubleshooting hardware issues, including identifying root causes. Experience deploying, upgrading, or decommissioning hardware. Valid driver’s licence, as travel between sites may be required.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. Relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Server+, or Network+, or Basic Structured Cabling (BSC). Background Check Requirements This role requires the ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements. The successful candidate must pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

title: Senior Logistics Technician
description:

You will prioritise work, guide other technicians, resolve issues, and help ensure equipment is received, tracked, moved, and dispatched accurately and safely. You will join Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, which supports the infrastructure behind services including Azure, Microsoft 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and Bing. This role offers opportunities to develop your technical expertise, contribute to process improvements, and grow your mentoring skills.
  
  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more. We bring a growth mindset to our work and build an inclusive culture grounded in respect, integrity, and accountability. Responsibilities Prioritise ticket queues and assign work to technicians, resolving or escalating issues that could delay inventory and asset management activities. Guide technicians through inbound and outbound logistics tasks, including deliveries, purchase order receiving, equipment movements, and shipment documentation.
  
  

Coordinate with third-party warehouses, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), suppliers, and internal teams to support timely deliveries and collections. Maintain accurate inventory records and help the team investigate and resolve discrepancies. Use your knowledge of processes and systems to support complex requests, clear blockers, and improve service quality. Demonstrate accountability for accurate, safe, and high-quality work while embodying Microsoft’s culture and values. Preferred Qualifications Experience in IT logistics, inventory and asset management, or warehouse and supply chain operations in a large organisation. Experience using equipment to move heavy loads, such as forklifts, pallet jacks, or chassis lifts.
  
  

Experience guiding colleagues, coordinating work, or resolving operational escalations. The successful candidate must pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

description:

**About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company**
---------------------------------------------------


Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.


Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.


Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Team Manager who wants to make a difference in our Secure Infrastructure domain.

**Secure Infrastructure**
-------------------------


Looking at the actual threat landscape today, it’s more important than ever to design and build infrastructure solutions that incorporate correct and relevant security measures. The team works closely together using their combined knowledge and experience gathered from different projects and Incident Response cases to help our customers stay ahead of the threat actors. We continuously help customers improve their security posture within cloud, data center, endpoint management, identity, M365, and networking.

**The Role**
------------


Strong cyber defense needs more than great technology. It needs experts who can do their best work and a leader who makes that possible.


As Team Manager within Secure Infrastructure, you will lead a team of senior experts across hypervisor platforms, on-premises infrastructure, networking, cloud, and Microsoft 365. They bring deep technical expertise. You bring the direction, coaching, and support that help them succeed together. This is a people leadership role, not a hands-on consulting position.


You will build trust with people who know their craft, coach each team member, and create opportunities for development and knowledge sharing. By listening closely, acting on feedback, and removing obstacles, you will help maintain strong engagement and enable the team to be high-performing. Your role is to support senior experts while respecting their autonomy.


You will also be the link between sales and consultants, bringing the right people into customer conversations, strengthening handovers, and improving the processes that connect customer needs with delivery.


As a member of the Secure Infrastructure leadership team, you will work alongside the Head of Secure Infrastructure and Tech Leads to shape the area’s development and turn shared priorities into progress with your team. You will report to the Head of Secure Infrastructure, who holds overall profit-and-loss (P&L) responsibility for the entire Secure Infrastructure team.

**Your Background**
-------------------


You are an experienced people leader with a good understanding of cybersecurity and consultancy business. You enjoy helping skilled specialists thrive and know how to provide direction and support without needing to have all the answers yourself.


You build trust through useful questions, honest conversations, and consistent follow-through. You are comfortable connecting technical and commercial perspectives and helping people work towards shared goals.


You do not need to be the deepest technical expert in the room. What matters is your ability to understand the context, recognize your team’s expertise, and create and enable the team’s conditions for people to succeed together.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* Experience in people leadership, including coaching, employee development, and building team engagement.
* A good understanding of cybersecurity and the ability to engage confidently with technical specialists.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust, provide constructive feedback, and navigate challenging conversations.
* Ability to connect technical and commercial perspectives and support collaboration between sales and delivery of consultancy services.
* Ability to translate shared priorities into clear direction and follow through on improvements.
* Fluency in English, both writing and speaking.

**Bonus Skills**
----------------

* Experience leading senior technical specialists in a consulting or professional services environment.
* Familiarity with infrastructure domains such as hypervisor platforms, on-premises infrastructure, networking, cloud, or Microsoft 365.
* Experience improving collaboration, handovers, and processes between sales and consulting teams.
* Experience using employee feedback and engagement measures, such as eNPS, to guide team improvements.

***Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Swedish work permit.***

**Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future**
-------------------------------------------------


If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company and learn from some of the best in their field.


So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

title: Senior Consultant - Data & Analytics
description:
**Om NOOS**
-----------


NOOS är en av Sveriges ledande konsultbyråer inom kommersiell strategi, teknik, digital marknadsföring och kreativt innehåll, med över 150 aktiva kunder. Vi förenar kommersiell och teknisk kompetens med kreativitet och AI-driven innovation, med djup branscherfarenhet särskilt inom ehandel och retail. Genom vårt breda erbjudande agerar vi som strategisk partner och hjälper våra kunder att driva långsiktig tillväxt och lönsamhet genom hela deras värdekedja.


Kulturellt tror vi på nära samarbeten, både med varandra och våra kunder, detta för att skapa en miljö där vi ständigt utmanas och utvecklas. Vi uppmuntrar nya idéer och att våga testa nytt, allt för att konstant driva våra kunder, branschen och oss själva framåt. Vi finns i Stockholm, Borås och Helsingborg!


**Om rollen**
-------------


Nu söker vi dig som vill äga hela kedjan från första datapunkt till ledningsgruppens beslut – på riktigt. Du vet att värdet inte uppstår när en dashboard går live, utan när datan går att lita på och analysen får kunden att flytta budget, prioritera om sortimentet eller ändra sin CRM-strategi.


Vissa uppgifter tar en eftermiddag, till exempel att hitta varför köp dubbelräknas i GA4. Andra pågår i veckor, till exempel att flytta en kund till server-side-tracking med Consent Mode v2, bygga datamodellen i BigQuery och ta fram underlaget som avgör nästa års budget. Hos oss jobbar du tillsammans med seniora konsulter inom bl a Commercial Strategy, Marketing, Tech och Creative.

**Vad du kommer att göra**
--------------------------


Du leder självständigt analys- och measurement-spår i våra kunduppdrag, från tracking och datamodellering till insikt och rekommendation, och säkerställer att vi ligger i framkant inom:

* Hur tracking byggs rätt från grunden: GA4 och Google Tag Manager, client-side och server-side, Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions och Meta Conversions API
* Hur dataLayer-specifikationer skrivs för kundens utvecklare och valideras innan go-live, så att datan håller över tid
* Hur data från e-handel, annonsplattformar, CRM och affärssystem samlas och modelleras i BigQuery eller Snowflake
* Hur BI-lösningar i Looker eller Power BI byggs för att användas i vardagen, inte bara vid lansering
* Hur marknadsföringens faktiska effekt mäts med attribution, inkrementalitetstester och Marketing Mix Modelling, och omsätts till konkreta budgetrekommendationer
* Hur kommersiella frågor om marginal, sortiment, kunder och kanaler översätts till rätt analys
* Hur AI och automation ökar kapacitet, kvalitet och hastighet i analysarbetet


Du är en självklar del av kunddialogen. Det är du kunden pratar med när något i mätningen inte stämmer, och du presenterar insikter för marknads-, e-handels- och ekonomichefer med tydlig koppling mellan siffrorna och vad kunden bör göra härnäst.


Tillsammans med övriga seniora konsulter:

* Bidrar du till metodik och arbetssätt som används i hela bolaget
* Är du med och sätter standard för tracking, datakvalitet, QA och dokumentation i våra uppdrag
* Utvecklar du vårt Data & Analytics- och Measurement-erbjudande tillsammans med teamet
* Coachar du mer juniora kollegor och delar med dig av din kunskap

**Vem vi söker**
----------------


Du har 5+ års erfarenhet av analys och mätning inom digitala bolag, som konsult eller in-house, men framför allt:

* Du tänker affär före data och börjar alltid i frågan, inte i verktyget
* Du har gedigen hands-on-erfarenhet av GA4 och Google Tag Manager, inklusive e-handelsevents, server-side-uppsättningar (t ex Stape eller Google Cloud) och felsökning i preview och DebugView
* Du kan tillräckligt med JavaScript för att arbeta tryggt med dataLayer och felsöka implementationer
* Du har praktisk erfarenhet av Consent Mode v2, CMP:er som Cookiebot eller Cookie Information, samt konverteringsspårning i Google Ads och Meta
* Du är tekniskt trygg i SQL och datamodellering, och har arbetat i BigQuery, Snowflake, Looker eller Power BI
* Du förstår hur media köps och mäts över sök, social och övriga kanaler. Erfarenhet av MMM (t ex Meridian, PyMC-Marketing eller Robyn) eller inkrementalitetstester är meriterande
* Du testar, dokumenterar och utmanar dina egna uppsättningar innan du skriver under på dem
* Du kan förklara en komplex analys, och dess osäkerhet, lika tydligt för en VD som för en utvecklare
* Du har gärna erfarenhet från retail, e-handel eller konsumentvarumärken
* Du har minst 3 års akademisk examen, eller motsvarande track record som visar analytisk skärpa
* Du ser AI och automation som en självklar hävstång, inte ett sidospår

**Varför NOOS**
---------------


Framtidens vinnare är inte de som har mest data, utan de som förstår den bäst.


Därför bygger vi ett bolag där:

* Affärsfrågan styr analysen
* Tracking, data, tech och commercial strategy är fullt integrerade
* Varje insikt ska kunna kopplas till faktiskt värdeskapande


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Digital Producer & Content Coordinator
description:
Vill du ha en spännande roll på Visit Sweden som har det officiella uppdraget att marknadsföra Sverige som resmål? Visit Sweden är Sveriges marknadsföringsbolag, med huvudsakligt mål att väcka nyfikenhet och intresse för Sverige hos resenärer världen över. Hos oss är du omgiven av engagerade och professionella kollegor.


Just nu söker vi en Digital Producer & Content Coordinator till vårt team inom Marketing & Production. Det här är en tjänst för dig som vill utvecklas inom digital produktion, koordinering och administration. I rollen ansvarar du för den löpande administrationen av Visit Swedens digitala innehålls- och bildbanker, inklusive hantering av avtal och rättigheter. Du planerar, koordinerar och genomför digitala produktioner, från brief till leverans i nära samarbete med Digital Producer & Content Manager.


Ditt jobb kommer att vara omväxlande och spännande i en dynamisk miljö. Visit Sweden är en organisation i ständig rörelse som erbjuder en miljö där medarbetare utvecklas och stimuleras. I verksamheten arbetar marknadsförare, kunskapsdelare, kommunikatörer, analytiker, projektledare, ekonomer och specialister inom PR, webb, sociala medier och event.


Trivs du i en operativ och genomförandeinriktad roll där du får arbeta med allt från foto- och videoredigering till strukturering av bildbanker och avtalshantering?


Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

**För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha:**

* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning.
* Minst ett års erfarenhet från kommunikationsbyrå, bildbyrå eller liknande verksamhet.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av foto- och videoproduktion samt redigering.
* Goda kunskaper i Adobe Creative Cloud (exempelvis Premiere Pro, Illustrator och After Effects).
* Erfarenhet av att producera, anpassa och leverera innehåll för olika digitala kanaler utifrån givna briefs, planer och prioriteringar.
* Erfarenhet av att administrera digitala innehålls- och bildbanker (DAM-system), inklusive arbete med metadata och taggning.
* Grundläggande kunskaper om upphovsrätt, marknadsföringslagen samt avtal och rättighetsfrågor kopplade till bild och media.
* Förståelse för tillgänglighetsanpassning av innehåll (ex. alt-texter) samt god förståelse för bild-/videoformat och CMS.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska.
* God vana av Microsoft Office-paketet.

**Det är meriterande om du även har:**

* Allmän erfarenhet inom marknadsföring och kommunikation.
* Kunskap om besöksnäringen.


Som person är du ansvarstagande och driver ditt arbete framåt på ett noggrant och kvalitetsmedvetet sätt. Du är strukturerad, prestigelös och delar gärna med dig av dina kunskaper. Du samarbetar enkelt med både interna team och externa produktionspartner samt bidrar med ett positivt och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt. Du är öppen och nyfiken samt vill utvecklas inom ditt yrkesområde.


Som Digital Producer & Content Coordinator har du ett operativt fokus på att skapa, leverera och administrera innehåll och produktioner utifrån verksamhetens behov.

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**

* Administrera och underhålla digitala innehålls- och bildbanker (DAM-system, bildbanker och videoplattformar) med metadata, taggning och innehållsstruktur.
* Skapa, anpassa och redigera foto- och videomaterial för olika digitala kanaler.
* Hantera avtal, upphovsrätt och rättighetsfrågor kopplade till bild, film och musik samt säkerställa efterlevnad av marknadsföringslagen och varumärkesriktlinjer.
* Tillgänglighetsanpassa innehåll för digitala plattformar (t.ex. alt-texter).
* Ge enklare administrativt och praktiskt stöd till organisationen kopplat till bild- och innehållsproduktion.


I rollen ingår du i avdelningen Marketing and Production och rapporterar till Head of Marketing and Production. Du har din arbetsplats i trevliga lokaler i centrala Stockholm.

**Om tjänsten**


Tjänsten riktar sig till dig som är i början av din karriär. Vi tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning där lön sätts utifrån befattning, kompetens, marknadsläge och prestation.

**Övrigt**


I denna rekrytering samarbetar Visit Sweden med Randstad. Kontakta gärna Lotta Carlsson på telefon 073 075 23 25 för mer information.


Sista ansökningsdag: 15 november 2026


Vi värdesätter och välkomnar mångfald – våra medarbetare är alla unika. Vi strävar efter etnisk och kulturell mångfald samt jämn könsfördelning. Vi tror på att upprätthålla en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och privatliv och att främja en inkluderande och kreativ arbetsplats för alla. Genom att marknadsföra Sverige som turistdestination och främja medvetna resor skapar Visit Sweden förutsättningar för att stärka landets attraktionskraft och konkurrenskraft.

title: Director of Product Marketing
description:
Ready to shape how innovative media technology is brought to market? We’re looking for an experienced product marketing professional to strengthen our positioning, sharpen our go-to-market approach and help customers see the value of our technology.


##### **About the role**


Net Insight is looking for an experienced Director of Product Marketing to shape how our media technology portfolio is positioned, brought to market and understood by customers.


In this hands-on role, you will own product positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy and sales enablement across our products and solutions for live sports, broadcast and IP/cloud-based media workflows.


As part of the MarCom team, reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will work closely with product and commercial teams to turn complex technology into clear and compelling customer value. You will bring a strong understanding of the market and our customers, while ensuring our commercial teams have the positioning, stories and tools they need to succeed.


##### **What you'll do**


* Define and drive the product marketing strategy for our media technology portfolio.


* Develop clear positioning, messaging and value propositions for different customer segments and use cases.


* Lead go-to-market planning and commercial readiness for new products, services and major launches.


* Translate complex technical capabilities into compelling customer benefits and commercial stories.


* Develop sales enablement content such as pitch decks, solution briefs, battlecards, case studies and customer presentations.


* Build strong market, customer and competitive insight to support both commercial and product decisions.


* Partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Commercial, Marketing, Operations and technical teams.


* Support strategic customer engagements, industry events, webinars, analyst briefings and thought-leadership activities.


##### **What we're looking for**


You are an experienced product marketing professional with a strong commercial mindset and the ability to connect technology, customer needs and business value.


We believe you bring:


* 5-10 years of proven experience in product marketing, solutions marketing, product management or commercial strategy within media technology, broadcast, telecommunications, cloud or another complex B2B technology environment.


* Strong knowledge of live sports production, broadcast workflows, contribution and distribution, media services or IP/cloud-based media workflows.


* Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for complex technology products or services.


* The ability to turn technical concepts into clear value propositions and engaging customer stories.


* Strong communication, presentation and storytelling skills, with confidence engaging both customers and internal stakeholders.


* Commercial understanding of areas such as pricing, packaging and service models.


* A collaborative and hands-on approach, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Sales, Marketing and technical teams.


* Curiosity about emerging technologies and experience using AI and digital tools to improve efficiency and ways of working.


##### **Why join us**


This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our technology is positioned and brought to market. You will work close to both customers and technology, helping shape how we communicate the value of our portfolio and strengthening our position in the evolving media industry.


You’ll join an environment where technology, commercial thinking and customer value come together, with the opportunity to influence both our market presence and future growth.


##### **Welcome to apply**


This is a permanent, full-time position based either at our headquarters in Solna, Sweden, or remotely in the UK.


For more information about the position, please contact recruiting manager Yaya Selva at yaya.selva@netinsight.net.


##### **About Net Insight**


*Net Insight (Nasdaq: NETI B) provides the highest performing, most open video transport and media cloud technology for content providers as the industry standard for flexibility and service across live contribution, distribution and remote production media workflows.*


*For over 25 years, the world’s leading content owners, broadcasters, production companies, service providers and enterprises have trusted Net Insight’s Emmy® Award winning Nimbra technology to guarantee media delivery. Today, Net Insight partners with hundreds of customers in over 70 countries to ensure media flows across managed and unmanaged IP networks, and the cloud – from anywhere, to everywhere. It enables customers to get the best from any mix of virtualized, cloud and IP technology and is the only platform to support all the major industry standards, protocols and clouds.*


*Welcome to Net Insight, where* ***innovation****,* ***collaboration****, and* ***trust*** *are the cornerstones of our success. As one team, we are committed to delivering value to our customers, contributing to the growth and success of our company. Together we create a dynamic and positive workplace where everyone is valued, engaged and empowered to make an impact*

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
When Anyfin goes down, someone’s loan payment doesn’t go through. Make sure it doesn’t. You open your laptop on Monday and find out the primary database failed at 3am on Sunday. Services reconnected in seconds and no customer noticed a thing.
  
  

We’d practised exactly that failover the week before. If that’s your idea of a good weekend, we should talk. The foundation is built. Now it needs to scale.
  
  

Anyfin helps people refinance expensive consumer credit on better terms. Since 2017 we’ve helped people across Sweden, Finland and Germany take back control of their finances. We’re profitable, we have a banking licence that lets us operate across the EU, and we’re getting ready to launch new products and enter new markets. Our ambition is to be a pan-European company by 2030.
  
  

**Every one of those steps puts more weight on our platform:** more traffic, more integrations, more markets and more regulators who expect us to prove that we’re resilient, not just say it. The team is small and intentionally so. We’d rather grow what each engineer can do than how many engineers we have. The actual job You’ll own reliability across the platform.
  
  

That covers how our services run on Kubernetes and GCP, how we deploy, how we scale and how we recover when something breaks. You’ll decide what “reliable enough” means for each part of the system and make it measurable. You’ll make problems visible before customers feel them. That means monitoring, alerting and logging that tell us what’s wrong and why, not dashboards nobody opens.
  
  

When an alert fires, it should matter. You’ll make incidents boring. You’ll shape how we respond, who gets paged, how we communicate and how we learn. That means blameless reviews that lead to real changes, not just documents.
  
  

You’ll build the paved road. Engineers should be able to ship safely and quickly without thinking about infrastructure every time. You’ll work on CI/CD, infrastructure as code and the tooling that makes the right way the easy way. You’ll help us meet the bar a bank is held to.
  
  

As a regulated lender, operational resilience isn’t optional. You’ll help us turn requirements like DORA into systems and practices that actually work, not just policies we can point to. You’ll keep an eye on cost. Scaling into new markets shouldn’t mean scaling our cloud bill at the same rate.
  
  

Reliability in an AI-native company AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s built into how we work across engineering, analytics, operations and product, and our tech team has built an AI-connected data and code environment on frontier models. That shows up in reliability work too. AI can help read logs, trace incidents and draft runbooks faster than any of us.
  
  

It also means more systems in production act on data without questioning it, and more automation can change things on its own. Part of this role is working out what reliability means in that world: where AI makes us faster, where it needs guardrails, and how we make sure we’re never the last to know when something goes wrong. The people You’ll work closely with backend engineers, data engineers, product teams and our engineering managers, who care a lot about getting things right. Sometimes a little too much.
  
  

Propose a new alert and someone will ask how many times it would have fired last month. We prefer it that way. They’re also generous with what they know, quick to laugh and happy to change their minds when you make a better case. As long as you can back it up.
  
  

This sounds like you if… You have solid experience in SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering, ideally in a product company where reliability directly affects customers. You’ve run production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment and are comfortable with infrastructure as code. You write real code, not just YAML. Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, Python and Go, running on Kubernetes and GCP.
  
  

Experience with GCP and Terraform is a plus, but you don’t need to know every technology in our stack. You’re comfortable reading, debugging and improving services, and the judgment you bring matters more than ticking every box. You’ve built observability that people actually use, and you’ve been on call for systems that mattered. You know the difference between an alert and noise.
  
  

You’re pragmatic. You care about reliability, but you know 100% uptime isn’t the goal and that over-engineering has a cost too. You can explain that trade-off to engineers and non-engineers alike. Experience from fintech, banking or another regulated environment is a plus, but not a requirement.
  
  

More than anything, you can tell us about a system you made more reliable. Not just what you changed, but what it made possible for the team and the business. A few practical notes This role is based at our office on Drottninggatan 92 in Stockholm, and we work from the office. We think great teams and culture are built when people meet in person, especially at this stage.
  
  

EU work authorisation is required. If you’d rather prevent the next incident than write the postmortem for it, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Receptionist Scandic Segevång, deltid 60%
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 20 november 2026
* Malmö
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


Strax norr om Malmö, ett par svängar in från E20 ligger nyrenoverade Scandic Segevång. Trots det naturnära läget är det nära till centrala Malmö och kommunikationerna dit är goda. Vi har en stor variation bland våra gäster, allt från business till semestrande familjer. Hotellet är en populär mötesplats för konferensgäster, lunchgäster och lobbyjobbare med en varm och välkomnande atmosfär: något som lätt smittar av sig på både gäster och medarbetare.


Våra gäster är det viktigaste hos oss och att vi levererar service till dem på en mycket hög nivå är vårt främsta fokus. Det gör vi genom en stark servicekultur och ett hotell i toppklass men den allra viktigaste biten är de som gör det otroliga arbetet för vi ska nå dit- våra medarbetare!


**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Segevång.**


Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.


Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!


Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**


Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**


För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.


Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**


Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.

title: Product Engineer - AI Product Experience
description:
#### **Why This Role Matters**


AI is rapidly changing how users interact with data, but most products still rely on manual workflows, fragmented tools, and steep learning curves. In this role, you’ll redefine how marketers explore, understand, and act on their data by building AI-powered product experiences.


The AI domain is at the center of how we bring AI to our customers-owning the full multi agent infrastructure end-to-end. Your work will directly shape how thousands of users move from raw data to insight faster, more naturally, and with greater confidence.

#### **Our Ways of Working**


We organize our work around domains and workstreams with clear areas of ownership. We work in small, iterative cycles-experimenting, learning, and deploying to production multiple times a day with high autonomy and close cross-functional collaboration.

#### **What You Will Do**

* Design and implement user-facing AI features, such as natural language querying, AI-assisted workflows, and intelligent insights.
* Own features end-to-end from early exploration and prototyping through system architecture, implementation, production deployment, and followup.
* Partner closely with product managers and designers to define interaction patterns for AI-driven user experiences.
* Evaluate and optimize the reliability, latency, cost, accuracy, and usability of AI features in production.
* Contribute to shaping Funnel’s approach to AI in the product, including tooling, design patterns, and best practices.
* Drive technical initiatives from idea to production. Make sure best practices are followed, e.g., testing, relevant code reviews, dry principles.

#### **Skills & Experience We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience building product-facing software as a fullstack and/or backend engineer.
* Product mindset with comfort navigating ambiguous problem spaces, driving technical direction, and collaborating closely with stakeholders.
* Forward leaning, you are a curious engineer, not afraid to try new things, learn from mistakes and move forward.
* AI native mindset treats AI as a fundamental part of your workflow, embedded into your ways of working, but you also know when not to use AI.
* Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications in production, including system performance evaluations and cost monitoring.
* Strong engineering skills with a track record of crafting high quality code that is maintainable over time and maintaining distributed systems that are fault tolerant.
* Cloud & Infrastructure operations experience designing and operating scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS), APIs, data pipelines, and observability.
* Experience working with data-heavy products and/or analytics tools would be an advantage.
* Familiarity with Amazon Bedrock or similar LLM foundation model platforms would also be beneficial.

#### **Why You Should Join Us**

* Build meaningful tech that powers millions of daily jobs for customers around the world.
* Help shape our next-gen platform as we grow and move toward an AI-first future.
* Enjoy real ownership with the freedom to design, build, and ship every day.
* Work with friendly, collaborative teams who care about quality and each other.
* Grow with us in a company that invests in learning, innovation, and people.

#### **Location & Eligibility**


At this time, we can only consider applicants currently residing in **Stockholm**, Sweden, who meet at least one of the following criteria:

* Hold Swedish citizenship
* Hold EU/EEA citizenship and reside in Stockholm
* Hold a valid Swedish work permit

**Office-first**


At Funnel, we have an office-first approach, and we work from the office a minimum of four days a week. We have lots of flexibility for when life happens, during the summer, through the holidays. We just like to avoid having standing remote days.

title: Service Owner
description:
At Intrum, you will grow by making a difference. You will do it in a highly international environment and in a supportive culture where effort counts.

**Vill du ta tekniskt ägarskap för dagens miljö och bygga Sveriges cloud operations för framtiden?**

 **Technical Service Owner - Cloud & Infrastructure (Late Collection)**

**Som ett marknadsledande kredithanteringsföretag har Intrum en bred kompetens inom inkassotjänster och vi gör affärer i 20 länder i Europa. Vi har mer än 10 000 erfarna medarbetare i vår grupp.**


Vår verksamhet handlar om att hjälpa andra. Hjälpa skuldsatta individer att ta sig ur svåra situationer. Hjälpa företag att få betalt så att de kan växa, anställa och blomstra. Vilket i sin tur är positivt för hela ekonomin. Du blir en väsentlig del av denna krets hos oss, vilket ger ditt jobb på Intrum en djupare mening. Oavsett din roll eller titel.

**Rollen**
==========


Intrum Sverige befinner sig mitt i en teknisk transformation där vi moderniserar vår IT-miljö och successivt flyttar tjänster från traditionell on-premise-infrastruktur till Microsoft Azure. Vi söker nu en Technical Service Owner - Cloud & Infrastructure som tar ett sammanhållet tekniskt ansvar för våra plattformar och tjänster inom Late Collection.


Initialt ligger ett stort fokus på att säkerställa en stabil, säker och välfungerande produktionsmiljö för våra befintliga system, där Nova är en central del. Samtidigt är rollen framåtblickande. I takt med att Nova moderniseras och på sikt avvecklas kommer rollen att utvecklas mot ett bredare ansvar inom Cloud Operations för Intrum Sverige.


Du tar tekniskt ägarskap för den miljö som håller Late Collection igång idag, samtidigt som du hjälper oss att bygga den cloudplattform som ska ersätta den imorgon.

 **Rollen rapporterar till Product Owner Late Collection** och innebär nära samarbete med utvecklingsteam, arkitekter, IT Operations, Security, centrala plattformsteam och externa leverantörer.

 **Plats för denna position: Göteborg.** Hybridarbete. Vi ser att hybridarbete, där vi som medarbetare kan arbeta antingen hemifrån eller från kontoret, skapar möjligheter att prestera och arbeta effektivt i virtuella och reella miljöer.

**Ditt huvudansvar blir**
=========================

* Ta ett sammanhållet tekniskt ansvar för tjänsternas stabilitet, tillgänglighet, kapacitet, prestanda och tekniska kvalitet.
* Äga och följa upp service health, tekniska risker, incidenter och återkommande problem samt säkerställa att permanenta åtgärder genomförs.
* Säkerställa ändamålsenlig monitorering, logging, alerting, backup, restore och disaster recovery.
* Ansvara för tjänsternas tekniska livscykel, inklusive patchning, versionshantering, end-of-life, teknisk skuld och avveckling av legacyinfrastruktur.
* Driva och koordinera vår fortsatta förflyttning mot Microsoft Azure, inklusive hybridintegration, operational readiness och cloud governance.
* Koordinera tekniska beroenden mellan applikationer, SQL Server, servrar, nätverk, identitetstjänster, Azure och externa leverantörer.
* Bidra till och driva en teknisk roadmap samt säkerställa aktuell dokumentation, runbooks och tydliga operativa arbetssätt.
* Följa upp tekniska leveranser, servicenivåer och åtaganden från interna team och externa leverantörer.

**Azure och vår cloud transformation**
--------------------------------------


En viktig del av rollen är att vara en teknisk drivkraft i Intrum Sveriges fortsatta förflyttning mot Microsoft Azure. Du arbetar med områden som Azure-infrastruktur, identity and access management, nätverk och connectivity, observability, säkerhet, automation, kapacitet och kostnadsuppföljning. Rollen innebär tekniskt ägarskap, men inte att du ensam ska utföra all drift. Du säkerställer att arbetet blir gjort, att risker hanteras och att miljön utvecklas i rätt riktning, oavsett vilket internt team eller vilken leverantör som utför den enskilda aktiviteten.

**Dina kvalifikationer**
========================

**Vi tror att du har**
----------------------

* Flera års erfarenhet av IT Operations, Technical Service Ownership, Cloud Operations, Platform Engineering eller en liknande roll.
* Stark praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och god förståelse för hur produktionskritiska cloud- och hybridmiljöer drivs.
* Erfarenhet av Windows Server och traditionell enterprise-infrastruktur samt god förståelse för nätverk, DNS, certifikat, identitet och behörigheter.
* Erfarenhet av monitoring, logging, incident management, problem management och strukturerad root cause analysis.
* God förståelse för backup, restore, disaster recovery, business continuity, patchning, sårbarhetshantering och hardening.
* Förmåga att felsöka komplexa problem över flera tekniska lager och att omsätta tekniska risker till tydliga prioriteringar och åtgärder.
* Erfarenhet av att koordinera interna specialistteam och externa drift- eller infrastrukturella leverantörer.
* God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
* En ordnad ekonomi.

**Det är meriterande om du har**
--------------------------------

* Azure-certifiering, exempelvis Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code med Terraform eller Bicep samt automation med PowerShell.
* Erfarenhet av Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights eller motsvarande observability-verktyg.
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft Entra ID, Azure networking, Azure Virtual Desktop och CI/CD.
* God förståelse för SQL Server, inklusive SQL Agent, servicekonton, prestanda, connectivity och backup/restore.
* Erfarenhet av migrering från on-premise till Azure samt modernisering eller avveckling av större legacyplattformar.
* Kunskap om ITIL och etablerade arbetssätt inom IT Service Management.

**Vem är du?**
==============


Du kombinerar ett starkt tekniskt intresse med ett tydligt ägarskap. Du trivs med att växla mellan operativa frågor här och nu och den långsiktiga tekniska riktningen. När flera team eller leverantörer är involverade skapar du struktur, tydliggör ansvar och driver arbetet till avslut. Du är pragmatisk i ett komplext legacylandskap, men har samtidigt förmågan att se hur standardisering, automation och cloud services kan skapa en säkrare och mer hållbar miljö.


Vi på Intrum vill bidra till ett inkluderande och mångsidigt arbetsliv. Vi accepterar våra olikheter och vet att detta är en styrka. Vi vet att vi alla är en resurs för samhället, oavsett ålder, funktionsförmåga, kön, religion, etnicitet eller sexuell läggning. Därför uppmanar vi alla att söka jobb hos oss. Kom som du är.


Intrum är en inkluderande arbetsplats och mångfald innebär att vi kommer att inkludera den mest kompetenta kandidaten oavsett funktionshinder eller andra omständigheter som försvårar en 100-procentig tjänst. Vi är öppna för dialog med kvalificerade kandidater som av någon anledning inte kan ta en heltidstjänst. Låt inte det hindra dig från att söka.

**Du agerar enligt våra värderingar. Våra värderingar är inte ord. De är allt.**
================================================================================


Bakom vår globala expansion och stora digitala transformation ligger fyra enkla men kraftfulla värden: Etik, Hängivenhet, Lösningar och Empati. Det är värderingarna som driver vår vardag, oavsett hur stora vi blir.

* Du har ett tillväxttänk och ser möjligheter i stället för begränsningar.
* Du är inställd på livslångt lärande och vill kontinuerligt utveckla dina färdigheter.
* Du har god digital kompetens och förstår hur data bidrar till bättre beslut och stabilare tjänster.
* Du är resultatinriktad och arbetar med kvalitet, professionalism och kommersiell medvetenhet.
* Du trivs i en snabbt föränderlig miljö och har ett inkluderande, öppet och flexibelt arbetssätt.
* Du förstår behoven och komplexiteten i en global organisation.

**Är du nyfiken och har frågor?**
=================================


Du är välkommen att kontakta rekryteringschefen för mer information: Product Owner Late Collection, Elias Ekström, Elias.Ekstrom@intrum.com. Kontakta ansvarig rekryterare för mer information om ansökningsprocessen.


Endast ansökningar som tas emot via vårt onlinesystem kommer att beaktas.


Do you feel that you might be the right person? Great! Apply now. Looking forward to hearing from you!

description:

Är du en person som trivs i gränslandet mellan verksamhet, data och teknik och vill vara med och skapa systemstöd och processer i världsklass? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig


Bilia satsar och har ett tydligt tillväxtmål och vi behöver fler engagerade medarbetare. Vi erbjuder dig en spännande och social arbetsmiljö samt goda utvecklingsmöjligheter. Bilias vision är att bli branschens bästa servicebolag och vi vill att du är med på resan.


**Om rollen**


Som Applikationsspecialist CRM för Jaguar Land Rover Import Sverige och Norge ansvarar du för utveckling, förvaltning och affärsmässig användning av CRM och relaterade digitala processer. Rollen fungerar som länken mellan verksamheten, återförsäljarnätverket, Jaguar Land Rover centralt samt interna och externa IT- och digitala partners.


Du arbetar med hela kundresan, från första digitala kontakt och lead till order, leverans och fortsatt kundrelation. Rollen kombinerar teknisk systemförståelse med kommersiell verksamhetsutveckling och passar dig som trivs med att omsätta affärsbehov till praktiska lösningar.


**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**


**CRM- och Salesforceförvaltning**


Du ansvarar för den löpande utvecklingen och förvaltningen av Salesforceplattformen för Jaguar Land Rover Import. Rollen innebär att säkerställa effektiva processer, hög datakvalitet och ett systemstöd som möter verksamhetens och återförsäljarnas behov. I rollen ingår konfigurering och vidareutveckling av objekt, fält, flöden, valideringar och automatiseringar. Att följa dataflöden mellan webbformulär, Salesforce och återförsäljarnas system samt att samordna felsökning med interna team och externa leverantörer är en del av vardagen. Du arbetar även med integrationsfrågor och utvecklingen av Experience Cloud för återförsäljarnätverket.


**Affärsanalys och processutveckling**


En viktig del av rollen är att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem till smarta och hållbara systemlösningar. Du kartlägger och optimerar processer inom bland annat lead management, försäljning, order och fordonsleverans samt driver förbättringsinitiativ som skapar affärsnytta och effektivitet.


**Lead- och försäljningsprocesser**


Du ansvarar för att utveckla och förvalta CRM-processen genom hela kund- och fordonsresan, från första kontakt till levererad bil och vidare kunduppföljning. I de fallen tar du emot centrala CRM-underlag som behöver omsättas i fungerande processer och lösningar för den svenska och norska marknaden. Genom strukturerad hantering av kund- och fordonsdata bidrar du till ökad uppföljning, analysförmåga och försäljningseffektivitet.


**Data, analys och rapportering**


Rollen innefattar ett stort fokus på data och analys. Du arbetar med att strukturera och kvalitetssäkra information, ta fram rapporter och beslutsunderlag samt identifiera trender, avvikelser och utvecklingsmöjligheter som stödjer verksamhetens kommersiella mål.


**Återförsäljarnätverk och användarstöd**


Du är en central kontaktperson för CRM-relaterade frågor från återförsäljarnätverket i Sverige och Norge. Genom nära dialog med användarna säkerställer du att processer och system fungerar i praktiken och skapar värde i vardagen. Rollen omfattar även utbildning, dokumentation och stöd vid införande av nya funktioner och arbetssätt.


**System och plattformar**


Du kommer att arbeta i och kring flera centrala plattformar och teknikområden, bland annat:


* Salesforce Sales Cloud
* Salesforce Experience Cloud
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* Digitala kund- och återförsäljarplattformar
* Webb- och reservationslösningar
* API- och systemintegrationer
* Data- och rapporteringslösningar


**Samarbete och kontaktytor**


Du arbetar tvärfunktionellt tillsammans med flera delar av organisationen, bland annat inom Sales, Marketing, Network och Customer Experience. Rollen innebär också nära samarbete med återförsäljarnätverket, Jaguar Land Rover centralt, interna IT- och digitala team samt externa systemleverantörer och utvecklingspartners. Rollen innebär mycket internationella kontakter varför goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift är ett krav.


**Om dig**


Vi tror att du drivs av att förbättra processer, skapa struktur i data och utveckla effektiva systemstöd. Du har förmågan att förstå verksamhetens behov och översätta dem till lösningar som skapar affärsnytta.


Du har mycket goda kunskaper i Salesforce Sales Cloud och är van vid konfigurering och rapportbyggande. Du har erfarenhet av kravställning, integrationer och testning.


Erfarenhet från arbete med Salesforce Experience Cloud och Salesforce Marketing Cloud är meriterande liksom erfarenhet från automotive-branschen.


Som person är du analytisk, lösningsorienterad och kommunikativ. Du trivs med många kontaktytor och har lätt för att bygga förtroende mellan verksamhet och teknik. Precis som i CRM-teamet är samarbete, servicekänsla och ett proaktivt arbetssätt viktiga framgångsfaktorer.


**Övrig information**


Tjänsten är placerad i Göteborg och resor ingår i rollen. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse, gärna så snart som möjligt. Urval och intervjuer genomförs löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 25 november.

**Who We Are**


M-Files is redefining how work gets done. Our context-first document management system offers purpose-built business use cases—spanning universal and industry-specific workflows—to enable secure collaboration, automate processes, and ensure governance.


Unlike traditional systems, M-Files organizes content around the context of your business, connecting documents to related people, projects, and transactions. With our unique metadata-driven architecture, organizations can model content in line with their business processes, unify information across silos, and apply AI at scale. The result is greater productivity, reduced risk, and smarter, faster decisions for over 6,000 customers in 100+ countries.

### **To learn more about us we encourage you to visit https://m-files.com/**

**About the role**


We are looking for a dynamic, results-driven **Services Sales Manager to join our EMEA team** . This is a role for an active, hands-on person who is not afraid to pick up the phone, and who is also a true team player. In this pivotal role, you will work closely with our Direct Sales teams and our Services customer team to grow our services business and make sure customers receive best-in-class solutions and ongoing support.

 **What you will do**

* Scope, price and present implementation services, managed services and premium support as an integrated part of new customer deals and expansion opportunities
* Proactively identify new services opportunities within our existing customer base and work with Sales to close them
* Partner with Direct Sales to understand customer needs and tailor service offerings accordingly
* Work closely with our Services customer team to identify value-driven proposals for our customers
* Ensure every service package is accurately scoped and priced for maximum customer value and optimal time-to-value
* Build strong customer relationships that uncover additional service needs
* Track and report on the services sales pipeline and outcomes
* Stay up to date on M-Files’ evolving services portfolio and on market trends in EMEA

  

**Requirements** **What you bring**

* 3+ years of experience selling professional services, implementation projects or managed services in SaaS, enterprise software or IT consulting
* A track record of meeting or exceeding targets, with examples you can share
* Experience with consultative, value-based selling to business and IT decision-makers, including senior stakeholders

title: Director of Product Marketing
description:
Ready to shape how innovative media technology is brought to market? We’re looking for an experienced product marketing professional to strengthen our positioning, sharpen our go-to-market approach and help customers see the value of our technology.

##### **About the role**


Net Insight is looking for an experienced Director of Product Marketing to shape how our media technology portfolio is positioned, brought to market and understood by customers.


In this hands-on role, you will own product positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy and sales enablement across our products and solutions for live sports, broadcast and IP/cloud-based media workflows.


As part of the MarCom team, reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will work closely with product and commercial teams to turn complex technology into clear and compelling customer value. You will bring a strong understanding of the market and our customers, while ensuring our commercial teams have the positioning, stories and tools they need to succeed.

##### **What you'll do**

* Define and drive the product marketing strategy for our media technology portfolio.
* Develop clear positioning, messaging and value propositions for different customer segments and use cases.
* Lead go-to-market planning and commercial readiness for new products, services and major launches.
* Translate complex technical capabilities into compelling customer benefits and commercial stories.
* Develop sales enablement content such as pitch decks, solution briefs, battlecards, case studies and customer presentations.
* Build strong market, customer and competitive insight to support both commercial and product decisions.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Commercial, Marketing, Operations and technical teams.
* Support strategic customer engagements, industry events, webinars, analyst briefings and thought-leadership activities.

##### **What we're looking for**


You are an experienced product marketing professional with a strong commercial mindset and the ability to connect technology, customer needs and business value.


We believe you bring:

* 5-10 years of proven experience in product marketing, solutions marketing, product management or commercial strategy within media technology, broadcast, telecommunications, cloud or another complex B2B technology environment.
* Strong knowledge of live sports production, broadcast workflows, contribution and distribution, media services or IP/cloud-based media workflows.
* Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies for complex technology products or services.
* The ability to turn technical concepts into clear value propositions and engaging customer stories.
* Strong communication, presentation and storytelling skills, with confidence engaging both customers and internal stakeholders.
* Commercial understanding of areas such as pricing, packaging and service models.
* A collaborative and hands-on approach, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Sales, Marketing and technical teams.
* Curiosity about emerging technologies and experience using AI and digital tools to improve efficiency and ways of working.

##### **Why join us**


This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how our technology is positioned and brought to market. You will work close to both customers and technology, helping shape how we communicate the value of our portfolio and strengthening our position in the evolving media industry.


You’ll join an environment where technology, commercial thinking and customer value come together, with the opportunity to influence both our market presence and future growth.

##### **Welcome to apply**


This is a permanent, full-time position based either at our headquarters in Solna, Sweden, or remotely in the UK.


For more information about the position, please contact recruiting manager Yaya Selva at yaya.selva@netinsight.net.

##### **About Net Insight**

*Net Insight (Nasdaq: NETI B) provides the highest performing, most open video transport and media cloud technology for content providers as the industry standard for flexibility and service across live contribution, distribution and remote production media workflows.*

*For over 25 years, the world’s leading content owners, broadcasters, production companies, service providers and enterprises have trusted Net Insight’s Emmy Award winning Nimbra technology to guarantee media delivery. Today, Net Insight partners with hundreds of customers in over 70 countries to ensure media flows across managed and unmanaged IP networks, and the cloud – from anywhere, to everywhere. It enables customers to get the best from any mix of virtualized, cloud and IP technology and is the only platform to support all the major industry standards, protocols and clouds.*

*Welcome to Net Insight, where* ***innovation****,* ***collaboration****, and* ***trust*** *are the cornerstones of our success. As one team, we are committed to delivering value to our customers, contributing to the growth and success of our company. Together we create a dynamic and positive workplace where everyone is valued, engaged and empowered to make an impact*
