In this role, you will be responsible for the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair of servers. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of data center environments, repair experience, and a proficiency in Linux-based operating systems. You will play a critical role in ensuring the stability, reliability, and efficiency in data center infrastructure.

**Experience, Skills and Qualifications Required**

**⁠Experience:**  

  

Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a data center environment, with a significant focus on hardware troubleshooting and repair  

A minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience with Linux operating systems (e.g., RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) in a server environment is mandatory

**Technical Skills:**


Expert knowledge of x86 server architecture and components  

Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing server hardware  

Strong understanding of network hardware, including switches, routers, and firewalls  

Solid command of Linux/Unix command-line tools for diagnostics and troubleshooting  

Familiarity with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) and ticketing systems  

Experience with structured cabling and fiber optic connectivity

**Certifications** (Preferred but not required)  

  

CompTIA A+  

CompTIA Server+  

CompTIA Linux+ or LPI certification  

Vendor-specific hardware certifications

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to safely lift, push, pull, and move items weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Walk, squat and climb for extended periods of time.
* Ability to work in environments that may include areas reaching temperatures of 90+ degrees Fahrenheit at times.
* Travel required up to 25%.
* Valid REAL ID or other federally accepted identification for U.S. travel.
* Reliable transportation for moving between locations on campus.
* Ability to work overtime and/or weekends as required.

Hardware Troubleshooting & Repair:  

  

Diagnose and resolve complex hardware failures on a variety of servers, including motherboards, CPUs, RAM, and storage devices  

Perform component-level repairs and replacements on servers and other data center hardware  

Manage and execute the hardware break/fix process, ensuring minimal downtime and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs)  

Conduct root cause analysis of hardware failures and provide recommendations for preventative measures

  

Linux System Administration:  

  

Utilize Linux command-line interface (CLI) for system monitoring, troubleshooting, and configuration  

Assist in the deployment and provisioning of new servers running various Linux distributions  

Troubleshoot boot-level and OS-level issues on Linux servers  

Work with engineering teams to resolve escalated technical issues related to the interaction between hardware and the Linux OS

Adhere to all safety and security protocols within the data center environment

title: Product Compliance Specialist
description:
**Join our highly skilled team of engineers, designers and product managers, breaking new ground and shaping the future of retail.**  

  

**We dare to dream big, we have the courage to keep raising the bar, and we’re committed to being a force for good in retail, helping both established and fast-growing brands meet the ever-changing expectations of their customers.**  

  

**Sitoo is a fast-growing technology company exploring how far we can take innovation to deliver the world’s best Unified Commerce Platform and Point of Sale. Our technology is used in more than 20 countries, a number that keeps growing thanks to our incredible teams in Engineering & Product. And we have no intention of slowing down. Are you the Product Compliance Specialist we’re looking for?**  



#### **Your mission at Sitoo**


We build a cloud-based point-of-sale and checkout platform for retailers in several countries. We are in an expansion phase and actively entering new markets. Each country has its own rules for recording sales, issuing receipts and invoices, and reporting to tax authorities. As Product Compliance Specialist, you make sure our product meets those rules. You track what is changing, turn legal requirements into product requirements, and get the product certified where needed.

#### **What you'll do**

* Monitor changes in fiscal, tax, e-invoicing and data-protection rules in our markets, and assess what they mean for the product.
* Own e-invoicing compliance: know each market's invoicing mandates and deadlines, and make sure the product can issue, send and store invoices as required.
* Research the legal and certification requirements before we enter a new country, and give a clear view of scope, effort and risk.
* Turn legal requirements into clear backlog items with acceptance criteria, and work with Product, Engineering and QA until they are built and verified.
* Lead product certifications and support audits by tax authorities, certification bodies and customers.
* Help run the controls that keep the product compliant after release, and coordinate the fix when an issue comes up.
* Keep requirement specifications, process documents and legally required documentation up to date.

#### **What you bring**

* 3+ years in product compliance, regulatory or requirements work in software or another regulated industry.
* You have taken compliance requirements from a legal text all the way into a live product.
* You can read a regulation and write precise, testable requirements from it.
* Practical knowledge of data-protection law and how it affects product design.
* Comfortable discussing data, integrations and system behaviour with engineers.
* A clear writer who works well across teams and pays close attention to detail.

##### **Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with fiscal or e-invoicing requirements for POS or retail software.
* A background in software development or testing.
* Experience working with auditors or a corporate compliance function.

##### **What success looks like in your first year**

* A regulatory overview of all our markets, including e-invoicing deadlines, reviewed with Product every quarter.
* At least one new market launched compliant and certified on time.
* Compliance requirements that engineers can build and QA can test without back-and-forth.

**Why Sitoo**


We are forward thinkers. By turning curiosity into knowledge, and knowledge into continuous improvement, we break new ground and shape the future of retail.  

  

We believe in an inclusive culture where everyone feels like they belong. We support each other, win together, celebrate success together, and overcome challenges together.  

  

Today, we are close to 120 dedicated experts with a positive and solution-oriented mindset. Most importantly, we take care of each other, and we never forget to have fun.

**The Good Stuff**


We care just as much about our team as we do about pushing the boundaries of retail. To make sure you have the support, balance, and energy to thrive, both in and out of the office, here is glimpse of what you get when you join us:

* 30 days vacation
* 5,000 SEK wellness benefit
* Gym membership discount
* Parental leave top-up
* Occupational pension
* Fika every Thursday
* AW on Fridays
* And more!

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
### **When Anyfin goes down, someone’s loan payment doesn’t go through. Make sure it doesn’t.**


You open your laptop on Monday and find out the primary database failed at 3am on Sunday. Services reconnected in seconds and no customer noticed a thing. We’d practised exactly that failover the week before.


If that’s your idea of a good weekend, we should talk.

### **The foundation is built. Now it needs to scale.**


Anyfin helps people refinance expensive consumer credit on better terms. Since 2017 we’ve helped people across Sweden, Finland and Germany take back control of their finances. We’re profitable, we have a banking licence that lets us operate across the EU, and we’re getting ready to launch new products and enter new markets. Our ambition is to be a pan-European company by 2030.


Every one of those steps puts more weight on our platform: more traffic, more integrations, more markets and more regulators who expect us to prove that we’re resilient, not just say it.


The team is small and intentionally so. We’d rather grow what each engineer can do than how many engineers we have.

### **The actual job**

**You’ll own reliability across the platform.** That covers how our services run on Kubernetes and GCP, how we deploy, how we scale and how we recover when something breaks. You’ll decide what “reliable enough” means for each part of the system and make it measurable.

**You’ll make problems visible before customers feel them.** That means monitoring, alerting and logging that tell us what’s wrong and why, not dashboards nobody opens. When an alert fires, it should matter.

**You’ll make incidents boring.** You’ll shape how we respond, who gets paged, how we communicate and how we learn. That means blameless reviews that lead to real changes, not just documents.

**You’ll build the paved road.** Engineers should be able to ship safely and quickly without thinking about infrastructure every time. You’ll work on CI/CD, infrastructure as code and the tooling that makes the right way the easy way.

**You’ll help us meet the bar a bank is held to.** As a regulated lender, operational resilience isn’t optional. You’ll help us turn requirements like DORA into systems and practices that actually work, not just policies we can point to.

**You’ll keep an eye on cost.** Scaling into new markets shouldn’t mean scaling our cloud bill at the same rate.

### **Reliability in an AI-native company**


AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s built into how we work across engineering, analytics, operations and product, and our tech team has built an AI-connected data and code environment on frontier models.


That shows up in reliability work too. AI can help read logs, trace incidents and draft runbooks faster than any of us. It also means more systems in production act on data without questioning it, and more automation can change things on its own.


Part of this role is working out what reliability means in that world: where AI makes us faster, where it needs guardrails, and how we make sure we’re never the last to know when something goes wrong.

### **The people**


You’ll work closely with backend engineers, data engineers, product teams and our engineering managers, who care a lot about getting things right. Sometimes a little too much. Propose a new alert and someone will ask how many times it would have fired last month. We prefer it that way.


They’re also generous with what they know, quick to laugh and happy to change their minds when you make a better case. As long as you can back it up.

### **This sounds like you if…**


You have solid experience in SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering, ideally in a product company where reliability directly affects customers. You’ve run production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment and are comfortable with infrastructure as code.


You write real code, not just YAML. Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, Python and Go, running on Kubernetes and GCP. Experience with GCP and Terraform is a plus, but you don’t need to know every technology in our stack. You’re comfortable reading, debugging and improving services, and the judgment you bring matters more than ticking every box.


You’ve built observability that people actually use, and you’ve been on call for systems that mattered. You know the difference between an alert and noise.


You’re pragmatic. You care about reliability, but you know 100% uptime isn’t the goal and that over-engineering has a cost too. You can explain that trade-off to engineers and non-engineers alike.


Experience from fintech, banking or another regulated environment is a plus, but not a requirement.


More than anything, you can tell us about a system you made more reliable. Not just what you changed, but what it made possible for the team and the business.

### **A few practical notes**


This role is based at our office on Drottninggatan 92 in Stockholm, and we work from the office. We think great teams and culture are built when people meet in person, especially at this stage.


EU work authorisation is required.


If you’d rather prevent the next incident than write the postmortem for it, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Seniora ingenjörer till Sigma
description:
Jobbeskrivning Tillverkande industri och försvarsindustri på flera orter i Sverige Vill du använda din erfarenhet för att lösa tekniska utmaningar och skapa konkret värde? På Sigma söker vi flera seniora kollegor inom underhåll, PLC och automation, elektronik samt radio och RF. Vi befinner oss i en expansiv tid och det händer mycket hos våra kunder. Nya satsningar, utvecklingsprojekt och ökade produktionsbehov skapar spännande möjligheter.
  
  

Sigma växer tillsammans med våra kunder och stödjer dem på deras tillväxtresa – från teknisk utveckling till effektiv och driftsäker produktion. Senior underhållsingenjör Vill du utveckla underhållet i tekniskt krävande produktionsmiljöer? Här bidrar du till högre tillgänglighet, färre störningar och ett långsiktigt underhållsarbete. Om rollen Utveckla förebyggande och tillståndsbaserat underhåll samt underhållsplaner.
  
  

Genomföra rotorsaksanalyser och driva förbättringar av utrustning och arbetssätt. Följa upp tillgänglighet, MTBF, MTTR, kostnader och förbättringsresultat. Bidra vid investeringar, modifieringar och driftsättning tillsammans med produktion och tekniker. Vem är du?
  
  

Du har minst fem års relevant erfarenhet av industriellt underhåll, teknisk utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Du är van vid underhållssystem och kan självständigt driva analys och förbättringsarbete. Meriterande: TPM, RCM, FMEA, SAP PM, IFS eller Maximo samt kunskaper inom mekanik, el eller automation. Senior automationsingenjör inom PLC Vill du utveckla automation som gör produktionen stabilare och effektivare?
  
  

Du arbetar nära utrustningen och tar ansvar från krav och programmering till verifiering och driftsättning. Om rollen Programmera och vidareutveckla PLC-, HMI- och SCADA-lösningar. Felsöka och optimera styrsystem, sekvenser, drivsystem och industriell kommunikation. Genomföra test, FAT och SAT samt driftsättning och teknisk dokumentation.
  
  

Samarbeta med produktion, elkonstruktion och maskinleverantörer kring tekniska lösningar. Vem är du? Du har minst fem års relevant erfarenhet av PLC-programmering och industriell automation. Du har gedigen kompetens i exempelvis Siemens TIA Portal, Beckhoff TwinCAT eller Rockwell Studio 5000 och är trygg i felsökning och driftsättning.
  
  

**Meriterande:** Profinet, EtherCAT, OPC UA, servodrifter, maskinsäkerhet och OT-säkerhet. Senior elektronikingenjör Vill du utveckla elektronik för avancerade produkter och system? Hos våra kunder arbetar du med tekniska vägval, konstruktion och verifiering med höga krav på funktion och tillförlitlighet. Om rollen Utveckla analog och digital elektronik, scheman och underlag för kretskort.
  
  

Arbeta med komponentval, simulering, prototyper och konstruktionsgranskning. Genomföra mätning, felsökning och verifiering samt hantera EMC-frågor. Samverka med mjukvara, mekanik, produktion och test genom produktens livscykel. Vem är du?
  
  

Du har minst fem års relevant erfarenhet av elektronikutveckling och teknisk högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande kompetens. Du är van vid ECAD-verktyg, exempelvis Altium Designer eller Cadence, och praktiskt arbete i labb. Meriterande: Inbyggda system, FPGA, kraftförsörjning, signalintegritet, EMC-provning och produktionsanpassning. Senior ingenjör inom radioteknik och RF Vill du arbeta med radiovågor, antenner och trådlösa system i tekniskt avancerade miljöer?
  
  

Vi söker dig som kan förena teoretisk förståelse med praktisk utveckling, mätning och verifiering. Om rollen Analysera och utveckla RF-lösningar, radiolänkar, antennsystem eller delsystem. Arbeta med vågutbredning, länkbudget, täckning och störningsproblematik. Genomföra RF-mätningar med exempelvis spektrum- och nätverksanalysator.
  
  

Simulera, integrera och verifiera lösningar samt dokumentera resultat och tekniska vägval. Vem är du? Du har minst fem års relevant erfarenhet inom radioteknik, RF eller antennsystem och teknisk högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande kompetens. Du har god förståelse för elektromagnetism och är van att omsätta analys och mätdata i fungerande lösningar.
  
  

**Meriterande:** HFSS, CST, ADS, MATLAB, SDR, radar, radiokommunikation eller elektromagnetisk kompatibilitet. Hos Sigma Du behöver inte kunna allt inom din inriktning. Vi värdesätter gedigen erfarenhet, teknisk nyfikenhet och förmågan att snabbt sätta sig in i nya problem. Som senior kollega tar du ansvar för tekniska lösningar, kommunicerar tydligt med kund och team och delar gärna din kunskap.
  
  

Du har god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Hos oss får du tekniskt utvecklande kunduppdrag, kompetenta kollegor och frihet under ansvar. Gemenskapen är viktig: vi delar kunskap, har roligt tillsammans och hittar regelbundet på aktiviteter, event och gemensamma äventyr. Placering: Olika orter i Sverige, med arbete på plats utifrån uppdragets behov.
  
  

Låter det intressant? Välkommen med din ansökan. Bifoga eller fyll i ditt CV, berätta vilken roll du söker och vilka tekniska miljöer du har arbetat i.
